review_candidates.description: Job Title: macOS Administrator Employment Type: Full-time Location : Hyderabad, India Experience: 5+ Years Joining: Immediate to 15 Days Work Model: 4 Days Work From Office, 1 Day Work From Home. About NationsBenefits: At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on platform modernization — transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core back-office functions in the insurance domain. We are seeking a macOS Administrator to own the implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and operation of our Mac fleet and the Apple device management stack behind it. This role serves as a high-level technical expert on macOS and Apple platforms and acts as L3 escalation support for issues with MacOS devices. If you have a passion for enterprise Apple device management, endpoint automation, and secure, compliant infrastructure , this opportunity is for you! Key Responsibilities: macOS Device Management & Deployment: Administer and maintain the macOS fleet using Jamf Pro and Microsoft Entra, including zero-touch enrollment, configuration profiles, policies, scripts, device inventory and application packaging. Deploy macOS updates, security patches, and third-party software on a controlled, tested rollout schedule. Enforce established secure configuration baselines (FileVault, firewall, Gatekeeper, compliance policies) on all Mac endpoints. Build and maintain scripts (Bash, Zsh, PowerShell) to automate deployment, remediation, and reporting tasks. Experience with standard enterprise configurations for Jamf/Apple (Platform SSO with Entra, Jamf Connect, etc) Support, Escalation & Troubleshooting Act as L2/L3 escalation support for the Help Desk and Desktop Support teams, working issues through the ticketing queue from outreach to resolution. Troubleshoot hardware, software, identity, and network issues on macOS, including Entra ID, Platform SSO, and ZScaler client connectivity. Open and manage vendor tickets, coordinating with vendor technical teams to keep Apple-related platforms fully functional. Security, Compliance & Change Management Coordinate with InfoSec on vulnerability and CVE-driven remediation, ensuring fixes are tested and rolled out in phases. Support IT certifications and audits (PCI, HITRUST) through documentation and evidence gathering. Participate in Change Management (CRM) and perform maintenance on impacted technology during change windows, including outside of production hours when required. Maintain accurate IT SOP documentation and respond to alerts from monitoring systems. Familiarity and experience implementing secure endpoint configuration baselines compliant with PCI, HITRUST, NIST, etc. Requirements: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience. Experience: 5+ years in IT, with at least 3+ years administering macOS in an enterprise environment. Hands-on experience with macOS workstation maintenance, deployment, and automation. Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment supporting end users and IT personnel. Technical Expertise: Enterprise MDM solutions: Jamf Pro (required), Microsoft Intune, and Apple Business Manager / Automated Device Enrollment. Proficiency in scripting and automation (Bash/Zsh, PowerShell) and enterprise RMM and EDR tools (N-able, ManageEngine, SentinelOne). Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory administration. Communication & Professionalism: Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present ideas in professional, user-friendly language. Self-motivated, with proven analytical and problem-solving abilities and a strong customer service orientation. Ability to prioritize, document, and execute assigned tasks effectively. Preferred Qualifications: Certifications: Jamf Certified Tech (JCT), Jamf Certified Admin (JCA), or Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP). Jamf 300 Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) is a plus. Why Join Us? Work with Modern Apple Infrastructure – Own the Mac fleet end to end on Jamf and Intune. Technical Growth – Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and network engineers on enterprise-scale projects. Innovation & Collaboration – Be part of a dynamic, fast-paced IT environment. Career Progression – Expand your expertise in endpoint management and Apple enterprise administration.
